annotation.prospective_contrast: At fixed u, compare histories that vary only history[3], including both active pairs and new held-out values of u and h. Also compare oldest-interval and newest-interval pulses across h to test whether the h-by-history effect is shared or interval-specific.
annotation.refutation_condition: Reject this representation if a fit-only refit has raw dev RMSE above 0.06 or misses any fresh hidden, random confirmation, or intervention-pair target by more than the stated RMSE criterion. A failure of this finite feature set does not refute history[3] dependence generally.
annotation.scientific_change: Replace the failed u,h-only response with a quadratic response in current drive, waiting time, and explicitly indexed oldest and newest history intervals. The active interventions preserve a large newest-interval effect; the fresh and observed contrasts motivate testing waiting-time modulation rather than treating the fitted C0 coefficients as supported.
